title.en: We will pick you up at the airport

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你的行李箱子呢？不见了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de xíngli xiāngzi ne? Bújiàn le ma?
lines.en: Where's your suitcase? Is it missing?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 别着急，好像在那边。我看看护照。
lines.pinyin: Bié zháojí, hǎoxiàng zài nàbiān. Wǒ kànkan hùzhào.
lines.en: Don't worry, it seems to be over there. Let me check my passport.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 那个年轻的高个子司机来接我们。
lines.pinyin: Nàge niánqīng de gāo gèzi lái jiē wǒmen.
lines.en: That young tall person is here to pick us up.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 他看上去很好。我们站在这儿等吧。
lines.pinyin: Tā kàn shàngqù hěn hǎo. Wǒmen zhàn zài zhèr děng ba.
lines.en: He looks nice. Let's stand here and wait.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你想吃点儿什么吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī diǎnr shénme ma?
lines.en: Would you like something to eat?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 不想。这件事很重要，我应该告诉谁？
lines.pinyin: Bù xiǎng. Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòngyào, wǒ yīnggāi gàosu shéi?
lines.en: No, thanks. This is important. Who should I tell?

grammar.name: The set phrases 看上去 and 看起来
grammar.explanation: Both mean "it looks" or "it seems", giving an impression from what you see.

examples.en: He looks young.

grammar.name: Question words without a question (1)
grammar.explanation: 哪儿, 什么, 谁 and 哪 can stand for something unknown or not important, like "somewhere" or "something".

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī diǎnr shénme ma?
examples.en: Would you like something to eat?

grammar.name: Multiple attributives
grammar.explanation: Several describers can come before a noun. Words like "that" and numbers come first, then longer descriptions, then short adjectives.

examples.en: that tall young person

exercises.explanation: 看上去 gives an impression from what you see.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: Would you like something to eat?

exercises.explanation: 看上去 goes before the description.

title.zh: 你们想吃什么就点什么
title.en: You can order whatever you feel like

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我又饿又渴！菜单呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yòu è yòu kě! Càidān ne?
lines.en: I'm hungry and thirsty! Where's the menu?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你们想吃什么就点什么，这儿的服务很好。
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme, zhèr de fúwù hěn hǎo.
lines.en: Order whatever you want. The service here is very good.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我什么都想尝。服务员，请拿三双筷子和两个勺子。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shénme dōu xiǎng cháng. Fúwùyuán, qǐng ná sān shuāng kuàizi hé liǎng ge sháozi.
lines.en: I want to try everything. Waiter, please bring three pairs of chopsticks and two spoons.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 今天不去了，点外卖吧。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān bú qù le, diǎn wàimài ba.
lines.en: We won't go out today. Let's order takeaway.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 也可以吃方便面，又方便又简单。
lines.pinyin: Yě kěyǐ chī fāngbiànmiàn, yòu fāngbiàn yòu jiǎndān.
lines.en: We could also have instant noodles. It's convenient and simple.

grammar.name: The pattern 又……又……
grammar.explanation: Use it to say that two qualities are true at once.

examples.en: I'm hungry and thirsty.

grammar.name: Question words without a question (2)
grammar.explanation: With 都, a question word can mean "any" or "every".

examples.en: I want to eat everything.
Everybody knows.

grammar.name: Question words without a question (3)
grammar.explanation: The same question word used twice refers to the same thing both times: "whatever... that...".

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme.
examples.en: Order whatever you want to eat.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 听说你搬家了，新房子怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ bānjiā le, xīn fángzi zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: I hear you've moved. How's the new house?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 这个小区挺好的，环境好，有花园。
lines.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū tǐng hǎo de, huánjìng hǎo, yǒu huāyuán.
lines.en: This housing estate is pretty nice. It's a good environment with a garden.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你累吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ lèi ba?
lines.en: Are you tired?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 累坏了！我昨天晚上才打扫完。
lines.pinyin: Lèi huài le! Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang cái dǎsǎo wán.
lines.en: Worn out! I only finished cleaning last night.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 冰箱和洗衣机都有吗？
lines.pinyin: Bīngxiāng hé xǐyījī dōu yǒu ma?
lines.en: Do you have a fridge and a washing machine?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 有。卫生间的灯要换，咱们明天再办。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu. Wèishēngjiān de dēng yào huàn, zánmen míngtiān zài bàn.
lines.en: Yes. The bathroom light needs changing. We'll do it tomorrow.

grammar.name: The adverb of degree 挺
grammar.explanation: 挺 means "quite". 的 is often added at the end.

examples.en: This housing estate is quite nice.

grammar.name: Complement of degree (1)
grammar.explanation: 坏了 after an adjective means "terribly". It is used mostly for negative feelings.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān máng huài le.
examples.en: I've been terribly busy these days.

grammar.name: 就 and 才
grammar.explanation: 就 shows that something happens early or quickly. 才 shows that it happens late or slowly.

examples.pinyin: Tā bā diǎn jiù lái le.
examples.en: He came as early as eight.
He didn't come until ten.

exercises.explanation: 才 shows that something happened late.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 坏了 after an adjective means "terribly".
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: This housing estate is quite nice.
He came as early as eight.

title.zh: 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样
title.en: This hotel is unlike any other

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样，特别干净。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiā bīnguǎn gēn biéde dōu bù yíyàng, tèbié gānjìng.
lines.en: This hotel is unlike the others. It's especially clean.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 除了房间以外，服务也很好。
lines.pinyin: Chúle fángjiān yǐwài, fúwù yě hěn hǎo.
lines.en: Besides the rooms, the service is good too.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我一点儿也不想走。你满意吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yìdiǎnr yě bù xiǎng zǒu. Nǐ mǎnyì ma?
lines.en: I don't want to leave at all. Are you satisfied?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 飞机晚点了，什么时候起飞？
lines.pinyin: Fēijī wǎndiǎn le, shénme shíhou qǐfēi?
lines.en: The plane is delayed. When will it take off?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我们再等一刻钟吧。假期还长。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zài děng yí kè zhōng ba. Jiàqī hái cháng.
lines.en: Let's wait another fifteen minutes. The holiday is still long.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 先骑马，再去看海，一定很好。
lines.pinyin: Xiān qí mǎ, zài qù kàn hǎi, yídìng hěn hǎo.
lines.en: First horse riding, then the sea. It's sure to be great.

grammar.name: The pattern 一……也/都 + 不/没……
grammar.explanation: This stresses a complete negative: "not even one" or "not at all".

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìdiǎnr yě bù xiǎng zǒu.
examples.en: I don't want to leave at all.

examples.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén dōu bú rènshi.
examples.en: He doesn't know a single person.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (9)
grammar.explanation: A 跟 B 一样 means A and B are the same. An adjective can follow 一样. The negative is 不一样.

examples.zh: 这家宾馆跟别的都不一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bīnguǎn gēn biéde dōu bù yíyàng.
examples.en: This hotel is different from all the others.
He is as tall as me.

grammar.name: The pattern 除了……（以外），……都/还/也……
grammar.explanation: With 都, it means "everything except". With 还 or 也, it means "as well as".

examples.pinyin: Chúle tā yǐwài, wǒmen dōu qù.
examples.en: Everyone goes except him.

examples.zh: 除了苹果，我还买了面包。
examples.pinyin: Chúle píngguǒ, wǒ hái mǎile miànbāo.
examples.en: Besides apples, I also bought bread.

exercises.explanation: A 跟 B 一样 + adjective.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 除了 with 都 means "everyone except".
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: He is as tall as me.
I don't want to leave at all.
exercises.explanation: 一点儿也不 is a complete negative.

title.en: Photos like these are the best

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 今天太阳好得很，我们去爬山拍照吧！
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān tàiyáng hǎo de hěn, wǒmen qù pá shān pāizhào ba!
lines.en: The sun is great today. Let's go up the mountain and take photos!

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 好！我对照相比较感兴趣。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo! Wǒ duì zhàoxiàng bǐjiào gǎn xìngqù.
lines.en: Great! I'm quite interested in photography.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你看，山上走下来一个人，树下有很多人。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, shān shang zǒu xiàlai yí ge rén, shù xià yǒu hěn duō rén.
lines.en: Look, someone is coming down the mountain, and there are many people under the trees.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 这样的照片才好看！张张都不错。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng de zhàopiàn cái hǎokàn! Zhāngzhāng dōu búcuò.
lines.en: Photos like these are the good ones! Every one is great.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你收到邮件了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shōudào yóujiàn le ma?
lines.en: Did you get the email?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 收到了。开完会我就回一封。
lines.pinyin: Shōudào le. Kāiwán huì wǒ jiù huí yì fēng.
lines.en: Yes. I'll write back as soon as the meeting is over.

grammar.name: Complement of degree (2)
grammar.explanation: 得很 after an adjective means "very". It is used in speech.

examples.en: The weather is very nice now.

grammar.name: Reduplication of measure words
grammar.explanation: Repeating a measure word means "every". 都 often follows.

examples.en: Every one looks good.
I'm busy every day.

grammar.name: Existential sentences (3)
grammar.explanation: Place + verb + direction or result + number + thing says that something appears or disappears at a place.

examples.pinyin: Hòubian zǒu guòqu liǎng ge rén.
examples.en: Two people walked past behind us.

grammar.name: The pattern ……了……就……
grammar.explanation: The second action happens as soon as the first is done.

examples.en: We'll leave right after eating.

exercises.explanation: 了 marks the first action and 就 the second.

title.en: You can even order takeout on a high-speed train

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 该上车了！检票了吗？
lines.pinyin: Gāi shàng chē le! Jiǎnpiào le ma?
lines.en: It's time to board! Have the tickets been checked?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 检了。听说高铁上还可以点外卖。
lines.pinyin: Jiǎn le. Tīngshuō gāotiě shang hái kěyǐ diǎn wàimài.
lines.en: Yes. I hear you can even order takeaway on the high-speed train.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 真方便！高铁越来越好了。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn fāngbiàn! Gāotiě yuèláiyuè hǎo le.
lines.en: So convenient! High-speed trains keep getting better.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 如果饿了，我们就点吧。
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ è le, wǒmen jiù diǎn ba.
lines.en: If we get hungry, we'll order.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你必须小心，这儿很多人。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bìxū xiǎoxīn, zhèr hěn duō rén.
lines.en: You must be careful. There are a lot of people here.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 行。我们在路口分开，别急。
lines.pinyin: Xíng. Wǒmen zài lùkǒu fēnkāi, bié jí.
lines.en: Okay. We'll split up at the intersection. No rush.

grammar.name: The pattern 该……了
grammar.explanation: 该……了 means it's time for something.

examples.en: It's time to board.

grammar.name: 如果……，就……
grammar.explanation: This pair means "if..., then...".

examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ è le, wǒmen jiù chī fàn.
examples.en: If we get hungry, we'll eat.

grammar.name: The set phrase 越来越
grammar.explanation: 越来越 + adjective means "more and more".

examples.en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

exercises.explanation: 如果 sets up the condition.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.
exercises.explanation: 越来越 goes before the adjective.
该 and 了 frame the action.

title.zh: 那条裙子比短裤更好看
title.en: That skirt looks better than the shorts

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 这条裙子和短裤，哪个好看？
lines.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi hé duǎnkù, nǎge hǎokàn?
lines.en: This skirt or the shorts, which looks better?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 裙子比短裤更好看，而且不比短裤贵。
lines.pinyin: Qúnzi bǐ duǎnkù gèng hǎokàn, érqiě bù bǐ duǎnkù guì.
lines.en: The skirt looks better than the shorts, and it's no more expensive.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 大小也合适，好看极了！
lines.pinyin: Dàxiǎo yě héshì, hǎokàn jí le!
lines.en: The size fits too. It looks fantastic!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 咱们怎么回去？
lines.pinyin: Zánmen zěnme huíqù?
lines.en: How shall we get back?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 不远，可以走着去。这个西瓜不但新鲜，而且很甜。
lines.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, kěyǐ zǒuzhe qù. Zhège xīguā búdàn xīnxiān, érqiě hěn tián.
lines.en: It's not far, we can walk. This watermelon is not only fresh but also sweet.

grammar.name: Serial verb sentences (2)
grammar.explanation: 着 after the first verb shows the way the second action is done.

examples.en: We can walk there.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (10)
grammar.explanation: A 不比 B + adjective means A and B are about the same. It is often used to correct someone.

examples.en: The skirt isn't more expensive than the shorts.

grammar.name: Complement of degree (3)
grammar.explanation: 极了 after an adjective means "extremely".

examples.en: This watermelon is extremely sweet.

grammar.name: 不但……，而且……
grammar.explanation: This pair means "not only... but also...".

examples.en: Not only fresh but also sweet.

exercises.prompt: 这件衣服不但好看，（　）便宜。
exercises.explanation: 不但 pairs with 而且.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 着 shows the way of going.

exercises.prompt: It's not only fresh but also sweet.
exercises.explanation: 不但 first, 而且 second.

title.en: Today I was discharged from the hospital

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你住院多久了？今天出院吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhùyuàn duō jiǔ le? Jīntiān chūyuàn ma?
lines.en: How long have you been in hospital? Are you leaving today?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 对，今天我出院了。上次来医院差不多两年了。
lines.pinyin: Duì, jīntiān wǒ chūyuàn le. Shàngcì lái yīyuàn chàbuduō liǎng nián le.
lines.en: Yes, I'm out today. It's almost two years since I was last here.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 以后注意健康，别太累。
lines.pinyin: Yǐhòu zhùyì jiànkāng, bié tài lèi.
lines.en: Pay attention to your health in future, and don't get too tired.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 医生说我得吃药。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō wǒ děi chī yào.
lines.en: The doctor says I must take medicine.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你怎么了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le?
lines.en: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 游完泳以后，我的耳朵一直有点儿疼。
lines.pinyin: Yóuwán yǒng yǐhòu, wǒ de ěrduo yìzhí yǒudiǎnr téng.
lines.en: After swimming, my ear has been a bit sore.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 别担心，感冒了要多休息。
lines.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, gǎnmào le yào duō xiūxi.
lines.en: Don't worry. When you have a cold you need more rest.

grammar.name: Extended use of the complement of direction (1)
grammar.explanation: 下去 after a verb or adjective means that something already started will go on.

examples.en: Go on talking.
The weather will stay cold.

grammar.name: Separable words (2)
grammar.explanation: Other words can go between the two parts of a separable verb, such as 完 in 游完泳.

examples.en: after swimming

grammar.name: Complement of duration (2)
grammar.explanation: With verbs that cannot last, such as 来 or 结婚, the time phrase says how long ago the action finished.

examples.pinyin: Tā lái Zhōngguó liǎng nián le.
examples.en: It's been two years since he came to China.

grammar.name: The pattern ……以前/以后/前/后
grammar.explanation: These go after a phrase and mean "before" or "after". The phrase comes first, the opposite of English.

examples.en: before eating
after work

exercises.explanation: 下去 means to go on doing something.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: The time word follows the phrase.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: After swimming, my ear has been sore.
exercises.explanation: 完 goes inside the separable verb.

exercises.prompt: It's been two years since he came to China.

title.en: It doesn't matter if you don't play well

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 为了比赛，我每天都在球场练习。
lines.pinyin: Wèile bǐsài, wǒ měi tiān dōu zài qiúchǎng liànxí.
lines.en: For the match, I practise on the court every day.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你打得越多越好！紧张吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ de yuè duō yuè hǎo! Jǐnzhāng ma?
lines.en: The more you play, the better you get! Are you nervous?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 有点儿。我担心打不好。
lines.pinyin: Yǒudiǎnr. Wǒ dānxīn dǎ bu hǎo.
lines.en: A bit. I'm worried I won't play well.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 打不好没关系，只是一场比赛。
lines.pinyin: Dǎ bu hǎo méi guānxi, zhǐshì yí cì bǐsài.
lines.en: It doesn't matter if you don't play well. It's only one match.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你知道刘长春吗？他是中国第一个参加奥运会的运动员。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào Liú Chángchūn ma? Tā shì Zhōngguó dì yī ge cānjiā Àoyùnhuì de yùndòngyuán.
lines.en: Do you know Liu Changchun? He was the first Chinese athlete at the Olympic Games.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我听不懂这个名字，他很有名吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ tīng bu dǒng zhège míngzi, tā hěn yǒumíng ma?
lines.en: I don't catch that name. Is he famous?

grammar.name: 为了……，……
grammar.explanation: 为了 gives the purpose of an action.

examples.pinyin: Wèile bǐsài, wǒ měi tiān liànxí.
examples.en: For the match, I practise every day.

grammar.name: Complement of potentiality
grammar.explanation: 得 or 不 between a verb and its complement says whether something can be done.

examples.en: I can understand.
I can't understand.

grammar.name: The pattern 越A越B
grammar.explanation: B grows as A grows: "the more..., the more...".

examples.en: The more the better.

exercises.explanation: 不 between the verb and complement shows it can't be done.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 不 goes between 听 and 懂.

title.en: You can return the book to me tomorrow

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你看完这本书了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kànwán zhè běn shū le ma?
lines.en: Have you finished reading this book?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 还没有。我把重要的句子都记在本子上了。
lines.pinyin: Hái méiyǒu. Wǒ bǎ zhòngyào de jùzi dōu jì zài běnzi shang le.
lines.en: Not yet. I've written the important sentences in my notebook.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 没关系，你明天再把书还给我。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi, nǐ míngtiān zài bǎ shū huángěi wǒ.
lines.en: No problem, you can return the book to me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 好，在你的帮助下，我的中文水平提高了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, zài nǐ de bāngzhù xià, wǒ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng tígāo le.
lines.en: Okay. With your help, my Chinese has improved.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 老师讲得清楚吗？
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng de qīngchu ma?
lines.en: Did the teacher explain clearly?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 当然。我们要努力，复习对话，做作业。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán. Wǒmen yào nǔlì, fùxí duìhuà, zuò zuòyè.
lines.en: Of course. We need to work hard, review the dialogues and do the homework.

grammar.name: The 把 sentence (1)
grammar.explanation: 把 brings the object before the verb to show what happens to it. Here it moves somewhere: 把 + thing + verb + 在/到 + place. 不, 没 and modal verbs go before 把.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang le.
examples.en: I put the book on the table.

grammar.name: The pattern 在……上/中/下
grammar.explanation: This gives a situation or condition, such as 在……下 for "with the help of".

examples.en: with the teacher's help
in one's studies

grammar.name: The 把 sentence (2)
grammar.explanation: 把 + thing + verb + 给 + person shows something passing to someone.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān zài bǎ shū huángěi wǒ.
examples.en: Return the book to me tomorrow.

exercises.explanation: 把 brings the object before the verb.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: 在老师的帮助（　），我提高了。
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: Return the book to me tomorrow.
exercises.explanation: 把 + thing + verb + 给 + person.

exercises.prompt: I put the book on the table.
exercises.explanation: 把 + thing + verb + 在 + place.

title.zh: 看来我没办法解决这个问题
title.en: It seems I can't solve this problem

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我的笔记本电脑开不了，看来我没办法解决这个问题。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de bǐjìběn diànnǎo kāi bu liǎo, kànlái wǒ méi bànfǎ jiějué zhège wèntí.
lines.en: My laptop won't turn on. It seems I can't solve this problem.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你请假还是发邮件？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qǐngjià háishi fā yóujiàn?
lines.en: Will you ask for leave or send an email?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我今天或者明天去找老张，他是我同事。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān huòzhě míngtiān qù zhǎo Lǎo Zhāng, tā shì wǒ tóngshì.
lines.en: I'll go and see Old Zhang today or tomorrow. He's my colleague.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我跟您一起把这些工作做完吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn nín yìqǐ bǎ zhèxiē gōngzuò zuòwán ba.
lines.en: Let me finish this work with you.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 对我来说，这是一个好机会。
lines.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhè shì yí ge hǎo jīhuì.
lines.en: For me, this is a good chance.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你愿意离开这个城市吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yuànyì líkāi zhège chéngshì ma?
lines.en: Are you willing to leave this city?

grammar.name: 还是 and 或者
grammar.explanation: 还是 is used in questions. 或者 is used in statements.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hē chá háishi hē kāfēi?
examples.en: Tea or coffee?
Today or tomorrow are both fine.

grammar.name: The set phrase 看来
grammar.explanation: 看来 means "it seems", drawing a conclusion from what you see.

examples.en: It seems he isn't coming.

grammar.name: The 把 sentence (3)
grammar.explanation: 把 + thing + verb + result shows the result of an action on something.

examples.zh: 我跟您一起把这些工作做完。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn nín yìqǐ bǎ zhèxiē gōngzuò zuòwán.
examples.en: I'll finish this work with you.

grammar.name: The pattern 对……来说
grammar.explanation: This means "for..." or "as far as... is concerned".

examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhè hěn zhòngyào.
examples.en: For me, this is important.

exercises.explanation: Use 还是 in questions and 或者 in statements.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 或者 is used in statements.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

title.zh: 这个季节天气变化很快
title.en: The weather changes rapidly in this season

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 这个季节天气变化很快，刚才还是晴天。
lines.pinyin: Zhège jìjié tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài, gāngcái hái shì qíngtiān.
lines.en: The weather changes fast this season. It was sunny just now.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你听，风刮起来了，下起雨来了！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, fēng guā qǐlai le, xià qǐ yǔ lái le!
lines.en: Listen, the wind is picking up and it's starting to rain!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 别怕，我带了伞。
lines.pinyin: Bié pà, wǒ dàile sǎn.
lines.en: Don't worry, I brought an umbrella.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我就喜欢春天。这些花都开了，我把它们记下来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiù xǐhuan chūntiān. Zhèxiē huā dōu kāi le, wǒ bǎ tāmen jì xiàlai.
lines.en: I just love spring. These flowers are all out, I'll note them down.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 星期天你想干什么？
lines.pinyin: Xīngqītiān nǐ xiǎng gàn shénme?
lines.en: What do you want to do on Sunday?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 或者去公园，或者坐船，都可以。
lines.pinyin: Huòzhě qù gōngyuán, huòzhě zuò chuán, dōu kěyǐ.
lines.en: Either the park or a boat trip, both are fine.

grammar.name: 或者……，或者……
grammar.explanation: This pair offers two or more options: "either... or...".

examples.pinyin: Huòzhě qù gōngyuán, huòzhě zuò chuán.
examples.en: Either go to the park or take a boat.

grammar.name: Extended use of the complement of direction (2)
grammar.explanation: 起来 after a verb or adjective shows that something begins or enters a new state. An object goes between 起 and 来.

examples.en: The wind has picked up.
It has started to rain.

grammar.name: The adverb of scope 就
grammar.explanation: 就 can mean "only" or "just".

examples.en: I only like spring.

grammar.name: Extended use of the complement of direction (3)
grammar.explanation: 下来 after a verb shows that something taking effort has been finished or kept.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ tāmen jì xiàlai le.
examples.en: I wrote them down.

exercises.explanation: The object goes between 起 and 来.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 下来 shows that something was kept.

title.en: My new neighbors come from the UK

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你认识新邻居吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ rènshi xīn línjū ma?
lines.en: Do you know the new neighbours?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 认识，他们是一对夫妻，来自英国。
lines.pinyin: Rènshi, tāmen shì yí duì fūqī, láizì Yīngguó.
lines.en: Yes, they're a couple from the UK.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 如果有空的话，我们就请他们来做客。
lines.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu kòng dehuà, wǒmen jiù qǐng tāmen lái zuòkè.
lines.en: If we have time, we'll invite them over as guests.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 好，一边喝酒，一边聊天儿。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, yìbiān hē jiǔ, yìbiān liáotiānr.
lines.en: Great, we can chat over a drink.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你把声音开得太大了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le.
lines.en: You've turned the sound up too loud.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 对不起，我把盘子拿出来，你放心。
lines.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bǎ pánzi ná chūlai, nǐ fàngxīn.
lines.en: Sorry. I'll bring out the plates, don't worry.

grammar.name: ……的话，就……
grammar.explanation: 的话 ends the "if" part of a sentence. It can be used with or without 如果.

examples.pinyin: Yǒu shíjiān dehuà, wǒ jiù qù.
examples.en: If I have time, I'll go.

grammar.name: The 把 sentence (4)
grammar.explanation: 把 + thing + verb + a direction or state shows how the action changes the thing.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le.
examples.en: You've turned the sound up too loud.
I'll bring out the plates.

grammar.name: 一边……，一边……
grammar.explanation: Two actions happen at the same time.

examples.en: Chat while drinking tea.

exercises.explanation: 一边 repeats for each action.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: You've turned the sound up too loud.
If I have time, I'll go.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 这本书我找了好久，它在哪儿？
lines.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ zhǎole hǎojiǔ, tā zài nǎr?
lines.en: I've been looking for this book for ages. Where is it?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 这本书被别人借走了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bèi biérén jièzǒu le.
lines.en: This book has been borrowed by someone else.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 那怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn?
lines.en: What should I do, then?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你先去图书馆网站查，然后再来。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù túshūguǎn wǎngzhàn chá, ránhòu zài lái.
lines.en: First check the library website, then come back.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 校长要看我们班级的节目？
lines.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng yào kàn wǒmen bānjí de jiémù?
lines.en: Is the head going to watch our class's show?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 看什么啊！他今天没时间。
lines.pinyin: Kàn shénme a! Tā jīntiān méi shíjiān.
lines.en: Watch what! He has no time today.

grammar.name: Passive sentences (1)
grammar.explanation: 被 shows that the subject receives an action, often an unwanted one. Adverbs and modal verbs go before 被. The doer can follow 被.

examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bèi biérén jièzǒu le.
examples.en: This book was borrowed by someone else.

grammar.name: 先……，再/然后……
grammar.explanation: This gives the order of two actions: "first..., then...".

examples.pinyin: Xiān xiě zuòyè, ránhòu kàn diànshì.
examples.en: First do the homework, then watch TV.

grammar.name: The pattern X 什么（啊）
grammar.explanation: Putting 什么 after a word disagrees with what was just said, showing surprise or doubt.

examples.en: What's there to watch!

exercises.prompt: This book was borrowed by someone else.
First do the homework, then watch TV.

title.en: I am basically half a Nanjing local

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你了解南京吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ liǎojiě Nánjīng ma?
lines.en: Do you know Nanjing well?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 根据我的了解，那儿的公园一个一个都很有名。
lines.pinyin: Gēnjù wǒ de liǎojiě, nàr de gōngyuán yí ge yí ge dōu hěn yǒumíng.
lines.en: From what I know, the parks there are famous, one after another.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 在你看来，平时游客多吗？
lines.pinyin: Zài nǐ kànlái, píngshí yóukè duō ma?
lines.en: In your view, are there usually a lot of tourists?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 不多。我在那儿住了十年，是半个南京人。
lines.pinyin: Bù duō. Wǒ zài nàr zhùle shí nián, shì bàn ge Nánjīng rén.
lines.en: Not many. I lived there ten years, so I'm half a Nanjing local.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我们走了不一会儿，就看到黄河了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒule bù yíhuìr, jiù kàndào Huáng Hé le.
lines.en: We walked for a short while and saw the Yellow River.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 这段河真漂亮！附近有老人在聊天。
lines.pinyin: Zhè duàn hé zhēn piàoliang! Fùjìn yǒu lǎorén zài liáotiān.
lines.en: This stretch of river is really pretty! There are old people chatting nearby.

grammar.name: The preposition 根据
grammar.explanation: 根据 means "according to" or "based on".

examples.zh: 根据天气，我们决定不去了。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù tiānqì, wǒmen juédìng bú qù le.
examples.en: Based on the weather, we decided not to go.

grammar.name: Reduplication of number + measure word
grammar.explanation: 一个一个 means "one after another" or "one by one".

examples.zh: 学生们一个一个地进来。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēngmen yí ge yí ge de jìnlái.
examples.en: The students came in one by one.

grammar.name: The set phrase 在……看来
grammar.explanation: 在 + person + 看来 means "in someone's opinion".

examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ kànlái, zhè hěn hǎo.
examples.en: In my opinion, this is good.

grammar.name: The set phrase 不一会儿
grammar.explanation: 不一会儿 means "in a short while".

examples.pinyin: Bù yíhuìr, tā jiù huílái le.
examples.en: In a short while he came back.

exercises.prompt: In my opinion, this is good.
The students came in one by one.
exercises.explanation: 一个一个 describes how they came.

title.zh: 我听说有的熊猫出国了
title.en: I heard that some pandas have gone abroad

words.meaning: half a day, a long time

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你听说了吗？有的大熊猫出国了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tīngshuō le ma? Yǒude dàxióngmāo chūguó le.
lines.en: Have you heard? Some giant pandas have gone abroad.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 它们是国宝。一般来说，熊猫每天吃竹子。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen shì guóbǎo. Yìbān lái shuō, xióngmāo měi tiān chī zhúzi.
lines.en: They're a national treasure. Generally speaking, pandas eat bamboo every day.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你看，这只一会儿爬上去，一会儿跳下来，真可爱！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè zhī yíhuìr pá shàngqu, yíhuìr tiào xiàlai, zhēn kě'ài!
lines.en: Look, this one climbs up one moment and jumps down the next. So cute!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 关于这个动物园，你了解多少？
lines.pinyin: Guānyú zhège dòngwùyuán, nǐ liǎojiě duōshao?
lines.en: What do you know about this zoo?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 冬天比夏天早关门一个小时。其实我也认得几只熊猫。
lines.pinyin: Dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān zǎo guānmén yí ge xiǎoshí. Qíshí wǒ yě rènde jǐ zhī xióngmāo.
lines.en: It closes an hour earlier in winter than in summer. Actually, I even recognise a few pandas.

grammar.name: 一会儿……，一会儿……
grammar.explanation: Two things keep changing back and forth: "one moment..., the next...".

examples.zh: 一会儿爬上去，一会儿跳下来
examples.pinyin: yíhuìr pá shàngqu, yíhuìr tiào xiàlai
examples.en: climbing up one moment and jumping down the next

grammar.name: The preposition 关于
grammar.explanation: 关于 means "about" and introduces a topic.

examples.zh: 关于大熊猫，你知道多少？
examples.en: How much do you know about giant pandas?

grammar.name: The set phrase 一般来说
grammar.explanation: 一般来说 means "generally speaking".

examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, tā bā diǎn qǐchuáng.
examples.en: Generally speaking, he gets up at eight.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (11)
grammar.explanation: A 比 B + 多/少/早/晚 + verb + number shows a difference in amount or time.

examples.zh: 冬天比夏天早关门一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān zǎo guānmén yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.en: It closes an hour earlier in winter than in summer.

exercises.explanation: 一会儿 repeats for each action.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: Generally speaking, he gets up at eight.
exercises.explanation: 一般来说 opens the sentence.

exercises.prompt: He gets here an hour earlier than me.
exercises.explanation: 早 goes before the verb, and the amount after.

title.zh: 我要多向认真的人学习
title.en: I will learn from people who are careful

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我这个学期成绩不好，心里很难过。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhège xuéqī chéngjì bù hǎo, xīnli hěn nánguò.
lines.en: My results this term are poor and I feel sad.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你不是很聪明吗？别害怕，你要多向认真的人学习。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì hěn cōngmíng ma? Bié hàipà, nǐ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí.
lines.en: Aren't you very clever? Don't be afraid. Learn from people who are careful.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你认为这有用吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ rènwéi zhè yǒuyòng ma?
lines.en: Do you think that's useful?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 只有努力，才能提高。
lines.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǔlì, cái néng tígāo.
lines.en: Only by working hard can you improve.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你到处找什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dàochù zhǎo shénme?
lines.en: What are you looking for everywhere?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我的手机关机了。今天很忙，明天更忙。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī guānjī le. Jīntiān hěn máng, míngtiān gèng máng.
lines.en: My phone is off. Today is busy, and tomorrow will be even busier.

grammar.name: The preposition 向
grammar.explanation: 向 means "towards", or "from" with verbs like 学习.

examples.en: walk to the left
We should learn from him.

grammar.name: The rhetorical question 不是……吗？
grammar.explanation: This looks like a question but makes a strong statement: "Isn't it...?"

examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì hěn cōngmíng ma?
examples.en: Aren't you very clever?

grammar.name: The pattern ……，更……
grammar.explanation: 更 in the second part shows that it goes further than the first part.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān hěn máng, míngtiān gèng máng.
examples.en: Today is busy, and tomorrow even busier.

grammar.name: 只有……，才……
grammar.explanation: This pair gives the only condition: "only if..., can...".

examples.en: Only by working hard can you improve.

exercises.explanation: 向 with 学习 means "learn from".
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 不是……吗 makes a strong statement.

exercises.prompt: Only by working hard can you improve.

title.en: I've learned how to make jiaozi

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 春节快到了，阿姨和叔叔让我去做客。
lines.pinyin: Chūnjié kuài dào le, āyí hé shūshu ràng wǒ qù zuòkè.
lines.en: Spring Festival is nearly here. My auntie and uncle have invited me over.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 你学会了包饺子吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xuéhuìle bāo jiǎozi ma?
lines.en: Have you learned to make dumplings?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 刚刚学会，包了大概五十个。只要多练习，就能做好。
lines.pinyin: Gānggāng xuéhuì, bāole dàgài wǔshí ge. Zhǐyào duō liànxí, jiù néng zuò hǎo.
lines.en: I've only just learned, and made about fifty. As long as you practise, you can do it well.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 真不错！从今天起，我也要学。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn búcuò! Cóng jīntiān qǐ, wǒ yě yào xué.
lines.en: Very nice! From today on, I'll learn too.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 刚才你们去哪儿了？
lines.pinyin: Gāngcái nǐmen qù nǎr le?
lines.en: Where did you go just now?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我们准备出发去晚会，二十多个人，三四个老师。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zhǔnbèi chūfā qù wǎnhuì, èrshí duō ge rén, sān sì ge lǎoshī.
lines.en: We're getting ready to set off for the party, over twenty people and three or four teachers.

grammar.name: Approximate numbers
grammar.explanation: Two neighbouring numbers give an estimate. 大概 and 多 also work.

examples.en: three or four teachers
about fifty

grammar.name: 刚才 and 刚刚
grammar.explanation: 刚才 is a time word for the moment before now. It can go before the subject and can be used with 不. 刚刚 is an adverb that goes after the subject.

examples.en: I went to the supermarket just now.
I've only just learned it.

grammar.name: 只要……，就……
grammar.explanation: This pair gives a condition that is enough: "as long as..., then...".

examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào duō liànxí, jiù néng zuò hǎo.
examples.en: As long as you practise, you can do it well.

grammar.name: The pattern 从……起
grammar.explanation: This gives a starting point: "from... on".

examples.zh: 从今天起，我要学习中文。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jīntiān qǐ, wǒ yào xuéxí Zhōngwén.
examples.en: From today on, I'm going to study Chinese.

exercises.explanation: 从……起 gives a starting point.
